ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High; approximately 80% high-intensity (white) to 20% low-intensity (black/dark grey) distribution across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous central zone; solid black peripheral band along the trailing edge and lower margins; dark grey/black mottling concentrated at the peduncle base and leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch; calculated internal angle approximately 68 degrees; vertical depth relative to lobe peaks is approximately 1/6th of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration; irregular pixel peaks and valleys (3-12 pixels in depth) across the entire trailing boundary, with maximum irregularity observed at the lateral distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature extending from the median notch to sharp, upward-tapering distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Significant clusters of high-contrast, circular calcified pixel groups (barnacles) localized on the extreme outer edges and tips of both lobes; scattered circular indentations on the interior white surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple vertical and diagonal grey linear disruptions (rake marks) concentrated on the right lobe and central region, breaking the uniform white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization on distal tips; extensive tooth-rake scarring across the central and right lobes; irregular notches on the trailing edge likely resulting from previous trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density calcified barnacle clusters at the extreme lateral points of both lobes, creating a distinctively jagged silhouette against the water background.
